query:
SELECT DISTINCT item_matches.backdrop_plugin AS "plugin!",
                              item_matches.backdrop AS "path!",
                              library_items.kind = 'movie' AS "of_movie!: bool", (SELECT json_group_object(namespace, value) FROM item_match_ids
              WHERE item_match_ids.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show'))
                              AS "ids?: String"
                       FROM item_matches
                       JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = item_matches.item_id
                       JOIN library_files ON library_files.id = library_items.file_id
                       WHERE item_matches.state = 'matched' AND library_files.library_id = ?
                         AND item_matches.backdrop IS NOT NULL
